subject: Re: HMC Swindles status: decision memo direction after the benchmark week
body:
All,

Closing the loop after the benchmark week. Headline numbers held up: 2.1x median ESS-per-flop improvement across the full target suite, and the checkpoint-and-retry wrapper meant zero human intervention over the whole sweep - exactly what we wanted before recommending this as a platform service.

Decision for the July 13 memo: we recommend productizing the preconditioned-HMC-plus-swindles pipeline as an internal inference service, phase 1 limited to the target families we benchmarked. The heavy-tailed divergence issue is mitigated, not solved, so those targets ship behind a 'best effort' flag with the retry wrapper mandatory.

One process note: Q3 OKRs locked on June 26, and this is in there as a data-platforms commitment, so the memo mostly formalizes what leadership already expects.

Thanks all - long window, well run.

Dmitri
